senses.gloss: (sub. דמעיא) ileum, the third division of the small intestines.
units: <cite ref="Gittin 69a:10">Gitt. 69ᵃ</cite> <he>כ׳ פטירתא</he> the ileum of a first-born.—

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 976:12">Yalk. Koh. 976</cite> (counting ten stations of the digestive process) <he>מכרוכא עבה לכְנַת מעיא</he> from the large winding (jejunum) to the ileum (corresp. to <cite ref="O01223"><he>סני</he></cite>(<cite ref="A00000"><he>א</he></cite>) <cite ref="D00473"><he>דיבי</he></cite>, <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 3">Lev. R. s. 3</cite>, a.
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 7:19">Koh. R. to VII, 19</cite>). [Koh. R. l. c. <he>כנת מעיא</he> some ed., read <he>בנת</he>.]
<cite ref="Sukkah 20b:5">Succ. 20ᵇ</cite> <he>חזו לכ׳ דפירי</he> Ar. (ed. <he>לכינ׳</he>, Ms. M. <he>לבנ׳</he>; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) are fit for baling fruits.
<cite ref="Ketubot 105b:15">Keth. 105ᵇ</cite> <he>כ׳ דפירי</he> a bale of fruits, <he>כ׳ דגלדני</he> of small fish.
